notes: 13 records audited on 2026-10-11. No record qualified as 'upcoming_or_current_intake' and none as 'genuinely_discontinued'. ARES (id 40): both official ares-ac.be URLs failed (empty body and an F5/TSPD bot-challenge interstitial), so the record is classified 'uncertain' - the local note claiming a closed 2027-2028 call with the next call expected in August 2027 could not be verified against any official page. Toloa (id 721): the Ministry for Pacific Peoples page returned HTTP 403, so evidence comes from Le Va, the named administrator acting on behalf of MPP. Several official_urls lists in the workfile contain unrelated domains (anr.fr, bs.china-embassy.gov.cn, sutd.edu.sg, wgtn.ac.nz, wur.nl) that are not awarding-body pages for their records; they were not used as evidence where a genuine awarding-body page was available. Where a page states only the closed round with no next date, the record is classified 'temporarily_closed_awaiting_announcement' even when the scheme is historically annual; 'recurring_next_intake_expected' was used only where the fetched official page itself evidences recurrence (annual wording, per-year editions, or explicit prior-round references).
